searchText: MSRP $156,079. New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Geneva 28VZ Luxury Class C RV. Features Dream Dinette Tankless Water Heater Valve Stem Extender More About This RV Bring the grandkids along with you in this versatile motorhome! You can get a good night's rest on the 60' x 74' queen bed in the rear private bedroom which also has closets, and the 52' x 96' bunk over cab is another sleeping space in addition to the 68' sofa and the 70' Dream Dinette when you aren't using it to enjoy a meal or play a card game. The chef can prepare their best home cooked meals in the fully equipped kitchen with the two-burner gas cooktop. Freshen up after a fun day at the beach in the split-style bathroom with the 24' x 36' shower across from the private toilet and sink. You will feel right at home in every one of these Thor Motor Coach Geneva Class C gas motorhomes! A premium one-piece roofing material and welded tubular aluminum roof and sidewall cage construction will hold up for years to come. Each model has unique living area arrangements, fully equipped kitchens, and residential vinyl flooring that are easy to clean. The touchscreen dash radio and back-up monitor lets you play your favorite tunes and prevent any bumps or dings. Come choose your favorite one today!
